migrationDesign.justification: The tracked unit starts from finance-current and the Caddy upstream is unchanged. Binding WebDir to the same symlink ensures binary and served assets change together; rollback restores both old environment bytes and old active target.
preWriteRequirements: fresh lease independently binds current env SHA-256, uid, gid, mode, unit, Caddy, active target, old root binary, and public old runtime truth
candidate archive has exact hash and extracts to the root-executable P0-142 layout
new release directory creation is no-replace and occurs before activation
env backup is an atomic same-directory hard link that fails if the backup name already exists

temporary env is root-owned in /etc/ynx, has exactly one target WebDir line, preserves every non-WebDir line, receives fsync before atomic replacement, and is re-bound to current uid/gid/mode before replacement
migrationDesign.rollback: Verify the backup exact old SHA, reconstruct an fsynced same-directory temporary env from it, atomically restore env first, atomically restore old active symlink second, daemon-reload/restart third, then require old public /version and /health hashes.

postSwitchRequirements.health: HTTP 200 plus JSON ok=true, service=ynx-finance, build.commit/version commit equality, custody=none, portfolio=read-only
